text:
Rohan: quick sync on meridianX int6 bringup — great cost reduction but a reproducible drop on tabular/multi-doc extraction slice
Priya: numbers pls (unit cost, latency, quality delta)
Rohan: unit-cost: fp16 ~= $0.019/1k -> int6 ~= $0.011/1k (~42% savings). p95 latency +6% with current batching. On the GTN long-narrative table slice: entity F1 dropped from 0.92 -> 0.83 (abs -0.09)
Ilya: ugh, 9 pts absolute on entity F1 is high. Is this concentrated to dense tables or repeats?
Rohan: concentrated. When inputs have repeated aliases and 2+ column tables the failure rate increases ~4x
Jess: hypotheses? quantized attention rounding? kv-cache precision loss? priming sensitivity?
Ilya: all plausible. I profiled attention logits and saw small shifts in tail mass near doc boundaries under int6; could change argmax for token-level entity picks
Priya: product needs a plan that preserves most of the savings while protecting the slice. Ops-friendly please
Jess: options: 1) rule-based routing (table detector -> fp16) 2) hybrid precision (keep KV as fp16, compute int6) 3) sampled shadowing + fallback on coherence fail 4) prompt transform that annotates entities before inference
Rohan: I trained a tiny classifier (table_det_v2) that flags table-like inputs with recall 0.96 on holdout and runtime ~1.8ms. Cheap enough for routing
Priya: product prefers automated rules. Jess, draft a policy for canary + staged rollout that preserves safety
Jess: propose policy snippet:
``npolicy: meridianx-selective-precision
classifier: table_det_v2
default: meridianX-13B-int6
canary: meridianX-13B-fp16 sample_rate=0.02 for flagged inputs
shadow: meridianX-13B-fp16 shadow_rate=0.05
fallback: on coherence_fail OR entity_f1_drop>0.04 -> route fp16
metrics: {entity_f1, coherence, p95_latency, unit_cost}
``n
Rohan: add auto-rollback: if coherence delta > 0.03 across 5k samples -> rollback and route flagged bucket to fp16
Ilya: also suggest a 1k hybrid-kv micro-bench (KV fp16 + int6 compute). If it recovers >80% failures with <15% cost increase vs int6, prefer that over full fp16
Priya: timeline: Jess to implement policy + dashboard; Rohan to run hybrid bench; Ilya to run 5k shadow eval; product to sign-off on thresholds
Jess: infra will add logging tags: `precision_route` and `classifier_tag`, and emit `unit_cost_estimate` per response for dashboards
infra-bot: Scheduled job created: meridianx-hybrid-kv-bench (1k) -> runs at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z
Rohan: shadow eval dataset: s3://redwood-eval/meridianx/long-narrative-shadow/5k.jsonl. I'll post results when ready
Priya: product note: if failing slice < 3% of revenue and savings >35%, product tolerates up to 4pt coherence drop but only with staged rollout + fast rollback
Jess: ops note: set autoscale_min=2 for fp16 fallback pool, alert on p95 latency + 15% within 10m
Ilya: I'll gather attention diffs for top 20 failing prompts to aid debug
Rohan: agree plan. Any objections to shadow->canary->staged rollout?
Priya: none from product pending first shadow results
Jess: infra ok
Rohan: thanks, will follow up with micro-bench + 5k shadow metrics.
